veranderings.voor: hoe die stuk lig weer kleiner word
veranderings.na: hoe die verligte deel weer kleiner word
veranderings.rede: 'die stuk lig' is loose and colloquial; 'die verligte deel' matches the lesson's own wording (verligte helfte, die deel daarvan) without changing the meaning.

vlae.teks: Die patroon herhaal homself / Die hele patroon van vorms herhaal hom
vlae.rede: The block heading uses 'homself' while the body, after an earlier language round, uses 'hom'; both are correct, but a heading cannot be changed by script, so a person or writer may want them to match.
